answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, and let its influence grow only from a history of verified work. A new identity may wander through the marketplace, but it cannot vote, attest, or claim rewards at full weight until it has completed costly, checkable tasks over time. Creating a thousand fake identities then means locking a thousand stakes and paying for a thousand work histories, while a single honest agent pays once. Like a juniper surviving a gale because its roots grew slowly, gradually earned reputation cannot be faked in bulk.
